plugin.name: Requirements and one manual step
plugin.description: Needs Fallout 4 VR 1.2.72, F4SE VR, VR Address Library for F4SEVR, BodySlide and a body with BodySlide sliders (CBBE; BodyTalk 4 for men). One manual step, once: in BodySlide pick the preset "CBBE Zeroed Sliders", tick "Build Morphs" and run Batch Build for your body and outfits. That writes the .tri files this mod deforms; without them nothing changes (the game tells you if they are missing). After that the mod hands out the BodySlide presets you have installed by itself. To add bodies, just install more presets. BodyTalk's flat-game hands (MaleHands.nif, 1stPersonMaleHands.nif, 1stPersonMaleBody.nif) make VR hands disappear: hide those three files in MO2.

plugin.name: No extra files
plugin.description: Everybody gets one of the BodySlide presets you have installed (CBBE's and BodyTalk's own presets, plus any you add). Nothing else is needed. Recommended.

plugin.name: Named characters by Silhouette (x1.5)
plugin.description: Adds Silhouette's BodyGen files (ReidenXerx, GPL-3.0, included with credit): Piper, Cait, Curie and about 200 other named people get the body its author chose for each. Female values x1.5 so they show in VR. Everybody else still gets your BodySlide presets.

plugin.name: Named characters by Silhouette (original values)
plugin.description: The same files with Silhouette's own values, unchanged. Realistic and subtle: hard to notice in VR.
